preregistration.legacyAssessmentEmbargo: Legacy scores, critiques, tags, Overall Commentary, and AI Extension remain prohibited until both scoring passes and adjudications are locked.

sample.selectionRationale: The smallest gate that stresses a high-close symmetric comparison, a lopsided asymmetric burden, and a multi-person pluralist format before expanding to ten complete reassessments.

debates.reason: Long-form, symmetric constructive burdens, technical analytic philosophy, and a high close legacy result.
Long-form presuppositional debate with sharply different constructive and critical burdens and a lopsided legacy result.
Four-person format with one classical-theist advocate and three distinct alternatives on the opposing side, stressing attribution and aggregation.

executionProtocol.argumentInventory: One isolated model task per debate constructs the complete burden map, 4–7 sections, move inventory, response links, evidence anchors, and locked weights from the blind packet.
executionProtocol.passA: A fresh isolated 5.6 Sol task scores the locked inventory without legacy material or Pass B.
executionProtocol.passB: A different fresh isolated 5.6 Sol task scores the identical locked inventory without legacy material or Pass A.
executionProtocol.adjudication: The orchestrator adjudicates only threshold-triggered differences after preserving both original passes.
executionProtocol.composition: A post-score task drafts representative quotes, critiques, Overall Commentary, AI Extension, tag review, and AI Extension novelty map from the locked result.
executionProtocol.productionIsolation: All artifacts remain under docs/calibration/v2.1/complete-gate and never update src/data/debates.js, production ledgers, or rankings.

hardGates.scoringPassIsolation: separate model tasks with no score or rationale leakage

reviewGates.note: Winner flips and rank changes are not automatic failures when transcript evidence justifies them, but exceeding either threshold requires explicit editorial review before expansion.

readinessRule.initialGate: All hard gates must pass. Review-gate exceptions require documented evidence-based adjudication.
readinessRule.corpusWide: The three-debate gate can authorize only an expanded ten-complete-debate gate. Applying v2.1 to all 195 debates requires that expanded gate and explicit editorial approval.

decision.reason: Overall score agreement and calculations passed, but move-level adjudication and winner-classification review thresholds were exceeded; quote verification, complete scorecards, and AI Extension novelty maps also remain incomplete.
